description: This Java source file defines the 'NoopCustomApiRoutesProvider' class, which implements the 'CustomApiRoutesProvider' interface. The class provides no-op (empty) Route implementations for both 'unauthorized' and 'authorized' methods, returning a rejected Route. It appears to serve as a placeholder or default implementation within an API routing framework.
